detail.longDescription:
I heard about Needle 2 and obviously had to test it immediately! 

Needle 2 is not a traditional LLM like the models you would normally run with Ollama. Instead, it uses a Simple Attention Network (SAN) architecture. With just 45M parameters, it is specifically designed for tool calling, device use and structured data.

For my test, I gave it access to Open-Meteo for real weather data and lspci for GPU detection.

And all of this runs on my Intel Core i5-650 from 2010, at around 16 tok/s and only ~58 MB of RAM. 

The screenshots show Needle retrieving the weather for Vienna and Oslo, as well as reading my GPU and system information.
